content.text: Waking now and then is common at 8, but every night for a stretch is worth a closer look. Tonight, keep the 2am wake-up boring. Keep the lights low, say very little, and walk her back to bed without a snack or screens. A steady wind-down earlier in the evening also helps, with screens off about an hour before bed. If it keeps going or she seems worried or unwell, mention it to her doctor.
